policy: Zero sampling parameters anywhere (roster, harness configs, transport); providers decided everything. Verified by per-trial config scan.

uptake.rp_arms: 28 deliberations, real focus questions, cross-family branches (GLM 5.3, DeepSeek Pro, Nemotron Ultra, Flash-hot)
uptake.noop_arms: 70 deliberate calls with fixed neutral results (directive mirror confirmed)
uptake.violations: 2 total: deliberate called with a bash-style command argument, rejected per contract

reliability.super_reducer_flakiness: 7 degraded reductions (HTTP 500/503) on flash-log trial; reward still 1. Motivates Mercury reducer swap.
reliability.query_optimize: 0/6 everywhere: hardest task under 900s for every arm

interpretation: Live deliberation (rp) never beats vanilla (ctl) on any paired task: deltas 0.000 glm53, 0.000 flash.
The directive alone (noop) matches or beats live deliberation: the only cross-arm difference in the pilot is noop 3/3 vs rp 2/3 on flash (query-optimize).
All arms share the 900s cap; deliberation latency displaces acting time. n=1 per cell: pilot-scale signal, not a significance claim.
Never pooled with Nemotron-family pilots: controllers, branches, reducer all differ.
